scope: Read-only C++ temporal runtime integration and CPU/HLSL layout review
reviewed_invariants: DrawConstants previous-world offset192, uint4 metadata256, size272 and aligned stride512 match HLSL. FrameConstants unjittered projection2992 and previous projection3056, size3120 and aligned stride3328 match HLSL.
Six MRT formats and RTV positions cover four material outputs, RGBA32F motion and R32_UINT object identity. Stable draw keys use entity/asset/primitive/node with fixed draw order.
Each swapchain frame waits its graphics and compute fences before descriptor and constant upload rewrites. Temporal resources alternate independently of swapchain indexing on the direct queue.
Resolve pass declares all current/history reads and history UAV writes. Initial read group clears through UAV transitions before sampling. Present release returns both history groups to Common.

Candidate world/camera state commits after successful Present and graphics Signal. History index advances only in that success path. Resize flushes both queues before target recreation and invalidates history.
Immediate reconnect request, new welcome generation, minimized entry and restored entry invalidate temporal state. Network polling remains before minimized early-continue.
Temporal constants use the unjittered output grid, current pixel jitter correction and previousUV-currentUV motion. Descriptor ranges hold nine SRVs and four UAVs.
